correctness.rationale: For each active subset F of tree edges the polyhedral nearest-point derivative is the orthogonal componentwise-constant projector Q_F; every F is realized with strict KKT multipliers. Tree cut indicators are a normalized ell-one basis modulo constants, giving exact Q_F variation norms. Boundary counting yields (|B| b_A+|A| b_B)/|S|; a two-vertex edge with degree sum at least five proves the 3/2 stability gap, and a broom provides the sharp n-vertex upper envelope. Finite distinct input pairs attain the local derivative ratios. Analytic quantifiers cover all finite trees; a standard-library exact-rational check tests 1441 trees and 43614 active forests plus finite KKT witnesses.

A complete connected-subtree exact formula, a sharp path/four-claw versus all-others contractivity discontinuity, and an attained near-linear worst-order broom law give structural characterization and practical stress-test witnesses.
